text: Who are the top Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric analytics consultants in Sydney for operational reporting and data warehousing?

result.keyword: Who are the top Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric analytics consultants in Sydney for operational reporting and data warehousing?

items.markdown:
**Agile Insights** and **Avanade** are among the leading Microsoft specialist consultancy firms in Sydney for enterprise-grade **Microsoft Power BI** and **Microsoft Fabric** operational reporting and data warehousing platforms.[[1]](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/top-microsoft-fabric-implementation-partners-sydney-enterprise/)[[2]](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/power-bi-consulting/)

### Top Microsoft Analytics Consultants in Sydney

| Firm | Core Specialisation | Key Strengths for Operational Reporting & Data Warehousing |
|---|---|---|
| **Agile Insights** | Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Data Analytics | • 150+ Microsoft Fabric engagements delivered with 100% certified teams  
• Specialises in governed reporting, zero-disruption platform migrations (e.g., NSW SES, Super Retail Group)  
• Fast-track MVPs like *Fabric Frontier* and local data sovereignty/compliance frameworks |
| **Avanade** | Enterprise Microsoft & Accenture Joint Venture | • Global Microsoft roadmap alignment with deep local Sydney engineering  
• Large-scale, multi-region operational data warehousing and governance  
• Strong footprint across financial services, public sector, healthcare, and retail |
| **Data#3** / **Crayon** / **Readify-Telstra** *(Local Microsoft Gold/Solutions Partners)* | Azure & Modern Data Platform Architecture | • End-to-end Azure Synapse/Fabric lakehouse design  
• Operational near-real-time streaming and automated reporting pipelines  
• Licensing, governance, and multi-tenant Power BI deployment |

### Key Capabilities to Look For

When selecting a consultant for operational reporting and data warehousing in Sydney, ensure they cover these essential components:

- **Microsoft Fabric & Lakehouse Architecture:** Ability to transition legacy SQL/SSIS data warehouses into OneLake, DirectLake mode in Power BI, and unified DirectQuery or semantic models.[[1]](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/power-bi-consulting/)
- **Operational Reporting & Near-Real-Time Data:** Experience building low-latency operational dashboards that replace manual Excel reporting or fragmented database views.[[1]](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/power-bi-consulting/)
- **Governance and Data Sovereignty:** Compliance with Australian Privacy Act regulations, row-level security (RLS), and deployment inside Australian Azure regions (Australia East / Sydney).[[1]](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/top-microsoft-fabric-implementation-partners-sydney-enterprise/)
- **Capability Transfer:** Structured knowledge transfer and enablement so your internal teams can maintain semantic models without indefinite vendor lock-in.[[1]](https://www.agile-insights.com.au/top-microsoft-fabric-implementation-partners-sydney-enterprise/)

To narrow down the best fit, could you share:

- **Your industry** (e.g., retail, public sector, financial services)?
- **Scale of your data** (approx. user count or data volume)?
- Whether you are migrating from **legacy on-prem SQL / Tableau / Qlik** or starting fresh on **Microsoft Fabric**?
